info.title: Aress FDP
info.description:
Aress API helps you get data from Aress Server. 🚀
There are several routes:

## Users
Endpoints for captcha, login, signup, and user data are in this section

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Operations with users. In order to **login** for a user, first you must get **captcha** using _/users/login_captcha_ endpoint. Each captcha has a unique identifier and a value, which is _base64_ encoded format of image or audio. Then user must solve captcha value and send it along with his/her credentials to _/users/login_ endpoint. You can use **Authorize** button on top of this page to login for test user.

get.description: Get captcha for a user. Captcha can be an **_image_** or an **_audio_**, depending on the **captchaType** param. In case of an image, you can also pass **captchaWidth** and **captchaHeight** for customizing the size of generated image.

post.description: Get access token using credentials for users. You must provide solved captcha value (_captcha_) and unique identifier of catpcha (_captchaUid_), along with user credentials (_username_ and _password_).**Important note**: _username_ can be either username, email, phone number or national code of user.
Get access token using credentials for test user. This method only works for **test** user. For login flow of real users, you must use _**login_captcha**_ and _**login**_ endpoints.
